hook:
full moon tonight.
pick a pile: what you're finally ready to let go of

piles.title: someone you keep checking on
piles.text: you already know how this ends. stop refreshing their page. the peace you want starts the day you stop looking.

piles.title: the version of you that had to be tough
piles.text: you got through it. you don't have to keep your guard up in every room now. soft isn't weak.

piles.title: a worry that isn't yours to carry
piles.text: you've been carrying someone else's problem like it's your job. hand it back. something finishes for you this week.

cta:
comment 1, 2 or 3
and what you're letting go 🌕
